Let  
\[
x_k=\frac{k}{3^k}.
\]
Then the original term becomes
\[
\frac{m^2 n}{3^m(n3^m+m3^n)}
=\frac{x_m^2x_n}{x_m+x_n}.
\]
So
\[
S=\sum_{m,n\ge 1}\frac{x_m^2x_n}{x_m+x_n}.
\]
By symmetry,
\[
2S=\sum_{m,n\ge 1}\frac{x_m^2x_n+x_n^2x_m}{x_m+x_n}
=\sum_{m,n\ge 1}x_mx_n
=\left(\sum_{m=1}^\infty x_m\right)^2.
\]
Now
\[
\sum_{m=1}^\infty \frac{m}{3^m}
=\frac{1/3}{(1-1/3)^2}
=\frac34.
\]
Thus
\[
S=\frac12\left(\frac34\right)^2
=\frac{9}{32}
=0.28125.
\]
